venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thu 9/17 (MOD JK).** Net $2,919 vs $1,969 target (148%); food $457; no events; comps $33.90 (1.2%); 90 guests / $32.43 avg. Weather 90/67. Second football Thursday in the books — bar and booths filled early, and guests who'd planned to leave stayed for the game; big positive effect on energy and sales (make sure every guest knows about it). Steady flow 5–8pm with a nice pop at 9pm; bartender and barback communicated well. Lots of new faces in town for Shaky Knees, which should carry into the weekend. Served until midnight; Keyshawn came up to help close. Someone deliberately wet all the tissue paper in every bathroom — all replaced. Kitchen: smooth night. Maintenance: main well sink clogging easily. 86 Angel's Envy, extra dry vermouth, D'Ussé. No incident; no no-shows charged. Favorite moment: guests staying for football instead of leaving. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Hot, humid, clear to partly cloudy
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thu 9/17 (MOD KK/MD/KE; Chef JMS).** Net $2,344 vs $3,218 target (73%); food $144; comps $35.80 (1.5% — gift, industry, resident); 81 guests / $28.93 avg. Hot and humid. Solid Thursday and first night of Thursday Night Football: low but steady start, volume grew ~7:30pm with a bachelorette group of 9. Clear positive effect from hosting the game — small groups gathered to watch, guests extended their stay, and some returned after going elsewhere. Specials sold well. Steady until ~11:15pm, closed at midnight wishing Kala happy birthday with Daisy and Jo from Fishmonger. Edy finished his last training night — proactive, accurate, great energy. Kitchen: John Michael held it down and was present on the floor. Maintenance: water accumulation near walk-in freezer door; well 1 soda tap handle. 86 veggie dogs, Guinness draft. No incident; no no-shows charged. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thu 9/17 (AM Evan + Josh; PM Walcott + Sanders).** Net incl. events $14,399 vs $11,307 target (127%); AM/DC $1,052, D&C PM $8,217, Garden n/a; non-event net $9,269; event net $5,130 (event food $2,910); total food incl. events $4,554; comps $179 (1.2%); 256 guests (Tock) / ~$56.25 avg. Warm, 70 and sunny — didn't rain on the event. AM: easy Thursday, espresso set up for the event, coffees restocked, good on syrups and teas. PM: fun, wavy service — all-at-once rushes then breathers; cut opener at 10 (later than usual, room was full). No Garden meant the lobby was never empty; delayed breaks and extra hands on bar were the solve. Great team vibes. Kitchen: super chill night for Lucas and Rand. Event: small Fox Rothschild LLP event, 15+ guests, 4–6:30pm in the Garden; Josh ran a taco bar and snacks; low-key and the group enjoyed the space (KW). Break make-up not complete. No incident; no no-shows charged. Favorite: reunited with the crew, surprise Rosenthal hugs, Evan Flynn. Entered by MS.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thu 9/17 (MOD Kyler; Chef Steves/Will).** Net $5,466 vs $5,900 target (93%); food $358, beverage $4,988, retail $120; no events; comps $129.28 (2.36%); 147 guests (Sevenrooms) / $36 avg. 80s and humid. Strong start with some large-party madness handled through teamwork; floor popping and guests in high spirits through the 6–8pm turn, then 'date city' until ~11, quiet, then a late midnight surge of cocktail-lounge energy. Member Everett and regular Evan Saez in. Top sellers: Native Lion, Rosalie, Burner Phone. Door (HP): 2/3 capacity at 8pm, full by 8:45, waves at 9:45 and 10:30 with short waits; slowed after 11:30, no seats after 1am but ~22 guests cozied in. Friendly faces Cole Tarrant, Seth from Bateman's, Devon and coworkers from Yawning Cobra; 4 birthdays. No no-shows. Kitchen: 86 oysters, cookies. Menu count 17/17; no breakage. Maintenance: loose under-bar light wire at service end; leak above downstairs bathroom. No incidents. Entered by MK.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Thu 9/17 (MOD Julian; Chef Saleh).** Net $5,680 vs $5,905 target (96%); Marquee $5,680 (food $1,008), Standing Room $0; no events; comps $338.95 (6.0%); 151 guests / $37.62 avg. Nice sunny day, not hot. Intense night: started slow enough to cut a bartender and server, then business picked up around 9pm and stayed consistent — another all-hands late night with a handful of VIPs (investors, industry, regulars, birthdays) all arriving adjacent to each other. Solid night overall. Kitchen: 86 chicken (batch went funky); Saleh running the kitchen solo again. Maintenance: CO2 water dispenser throwing out black sludge. Low on fries. No incident; no no-shows charged. Favorite: ran into an old coworker from first bar job (Hotel Indigo), ~10 years ago. Entered by Julian Catano.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Thu 9/17 (MOD Marcus).** Net incl. events $4,191.77 vs $4,271 target (98%); Marquee bar sales $4,626.64; food $606; no events; comps $43.60 (1.0% — industry $2.60, DNL $41); 109 guests (80 walk-in / 29 reso); reported check avg $28.32. Perfect weather. Fun one: steady build with a pop ~7:30, full by 8, plenty of campers, then a big 10pm rush of groups splitting between the bar and the 30s; lots of tables growing on the fly (+4 in some cases). Jesse, Jada and Ben held the bartop; Chazmen great on the floor and jumped on dish; Rasaan killed it in the kitchen prepping for a big weekend. Cut host Devan ~9pm; kept opening server Tyler until midnight anticipating event foot traffic — good call. Last call landed naturally at 12:30, clear by 1:15. Kitchen close not checked. Went well: energy, hustle, connection. Do better: pre-bussing and resetting to zero. Maintenance: curtains. No incident; no no-shows charged. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Clear and bright; heat letting up
venues.narrative: **MG — Thu 9/17 (AM Franck & Lex; PM James & Marcus).** Net $7,998 vs $6,815 target (117%); Municipal Bar AM $1,674 / PM $4,890, Sun Club $306, Hot Eye $1,063; food $2,937; no events; comps $323 (4.0%); 114 OpenTable guests (4 AM + 110 PM) / ~$70.16 avg. Clear and bright, brutal heat letting up. AM: fairly tame with a lunch pop at noon; Sierra solo, excellent, stayed to support a busy happy hour. PM: happy hour put the team in the weeds right away; leveled off once Eryn hit the bar and closers came online, then a great dinner rush. Room emptied ~9:30 to mostly walk-ins at the bar. Sun Club: quiet, a few guests, little food, no 86s. Hot Eye: quiet; a couple of large groups from the conference in town plus tourists and industry. Kitchen: great pacing, nothing sent back, quickly corrected a manager mistake (James); 86 pickles (back tomorrow AM). No incident. Favorite: a baby lizard joined THE tonight. Entered by Alexis.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Thu 9/17 (MOD Julian Abel).** Net $11,518 vs $7,000 target (165%); food $1,982; comps ~$700 incl. $100 shifties (6.1% — lots of BOH staff in the house and a few former managers shown love); 232 guests / $49.75 avg. Perfect weather, lots of walk-ins. (Form day-of-week typed 'Friday'; notes and post time confirm Thursday.) Julian in well 300 shaking off the rust; shout-out to Tessa for ringing in all the Compendium drinks. Need a pow-wow on martini service — miscommunication about sidecar use. Door velocity crept up but Malachi and Cass throttled the door masterfully. Spoke with Theresa Lewis about a possible January buyout. Kitchen: Wes solo and did great; family meal for all. Maintenance: glassware, menu reprints, carbonator. 86 usual food items. No incident; no no-shows charged. Favorite: guests calling Julian their new favorite bartender. Entered by Julian Abel.
